about: How to cross each Act 1 zone: a short hint under each checklist row (by step id) and a line or two for the whole zone. Community patterns, checked against the game's layout graphs; evidence in docs/act1-zone-tips.md. The zones' schematics are in act1-drawings.json.

sources.data: The game's layout graphs: every possible layout of the zone, counted (scripts/zone-layout-stats.mjs).
sources.codex: Mobalytics, Campaign Layout Guide: Act 1 (Lolcohol, Campaign Codex), updated 2026-05-23.
sources.poe2way: poe2way.com act guide, Act 1 (layout tips tagged 0.5.0).
sources.maxroll: Maxroll, Path of Exile 2 Campaign Guide, updated 2026-06-02.
sources.aoeah: AOEAH, PoE 2 0.5 Campaign Speedrun & Fast Leveling Route Guide, 2026-05-22.
sources.domistae: Domistae poe2-leveling, poe2_act1_guide.html at f682e2b (0.5.5): the route files' source; its boss notes.
sources.poevault: poe-vault.com, Act 1 Boss Guide: each boss's attacks and phases (no date or version given; read 2026-11-13).
sources.gtd: GuyThatDies, "I Spent One Month Making This Campaign Guide", YouTube UdIsZHbhXOY, 2026-04-23 (0.5): the fastest route, zone by zone.
sources.maxroll-ls: ZiggyD, "The Comprehensive League Start Leveling Guide", Maxroll, for 0.5.5, updated 2026-09-08: gear and flask checkpoints by level.
sources.maxroll-secrets: ZiggyD, "Act 1 Campaign Secrets Guide", Maxroll, updated 2025-08-27 (0.3.0): where each Act 1 secret is.

kill-bloated-miller.text: Far corner fight: then walk past into town.

enter-mud-burrow.text: By the waypoint, to one side of the start.

abandoned-stash.text: Campsite, the other side of the start.

grelwood-waypoint.text: Follow the glowing roots to the Tree of Souls.

general.text: Found an exit first? Take its WP, come back.
The cauldron in Areagne's hut: medium flasks.

obelisks-of-rust.text: Open weapon racks on the way: better weapons.

enter-cemetery.text: Talk to Una, then respawn: skips her song.

kill-ervig.text: Off to one side near the end.

enter-mausoleum.text: Halfway in, on a side wall.

enter-tomb.text: Halfway in, on the other side wall.

memorial-gate.text: Then respawn at checkpoint to skip the talk.

kill-lachlann.text: Skips a long cutscene; Hooded One comes later.

general.text: Click a checkpoint to travel to another.

kill-draven.text: Wheel tile, then far end; else the long wall.

forgotten-riches.text: By a checkpoint; switch on a pillar nearby.

kill-asinia.text: Caged in bone? Break one wall to get out.

kill-crowbell.text: Roll when he leaps: the slam can one-shot.

hunting-grounds-to-freythorn.text: After the ritual, follow the locusts.

general.text: Places sit in the corners: follow the edges.

ritual-altars.text: Follow altar smoke; locusts point to the next.

kill-king-in-the-mists.text: Meditation: stand still. Dance: keep moving.

unas-lute.text: Close, behind a long hut with carts.

smithing-tools.text: Cobble road; the room with a checkpoint.

blacksmiths-chest.text: In the workshop with the smithing tools.

enter-ogham-manor.text: Follow the U round to the far side.

gallows-secret.text: Midway, by a checkpoint: up to the hanged man.

kill-candlemass.text: First floor, far wall: read the Psalm.

kill-geonor.text: Each floor: go the opposite way; far end.
Keep off his frost sigils: they freeze you.

general.text: Boots with movement speed; damage gloves.
A better weapon, if a vendor has one.
Level 10: the next weapon base from a vendor.
Level 10: greater flasks from Una, if needed.
